title: Lulu and the Little Ladybird | Bedtime Story for Kids
description:
The rain stops and Lulu finds a little ladybird on the grass. Her home is up on a big flower, but her wings are wet.
Lulu makes a leaf bridge, and the ladybird walks up: step, step, step! The sun dries her wings. Thank you, Lulu!
The sun goes down and the two friends fall asleep.
A calm bedtime story for children aged 3 to 6.
